signals.summary: Oracle cut about 30% of its Revenue and Health Sciences division, the unit housing Cerner/Oracle Health.
Oracle terminated roughly 30,000 employees in the largest workforce reduction in its history.
Kansas City, home of Cerner's legacy campus, confirmed 539 layoffs via WARN Act filings.
Oracle reported Q3 FY26 revenue of $17.2 billion, up 22% year over year.
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure grew 84% and remaining performance obligations backlog rose 325% to $553 billion.
The VA's Oracle EHR contract grew from $10 billion to an estimated $37 billion amid delays and incidents.
